name: WonderTax Labs: Audita
author: wondertaxlabs

sections.description:
Automate Your Sales Tax Compliance

WonderTax Labs: Audita seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with WonderTax Labs for automated sales tax tracking, compliance, and real-time tax calculation at checkout.

Features

  • Real-Time Tax Calculation – Accurate sales tax rates calculated during checkout based on customer location
  • Block Checkout Support – Full compatibility with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks
  • Automatic Order Sync – All orders automatically synced to WonderTax Labs for tax compliance tracking
  • Multi-Jurisdiction Support – Handles complex tax scenarios across all US states and jurisdictions
  • Historical Order Import – Import and analyze past orders for comprehensive tax compliance
  • Secure Integration – Enterprise-grade encryption for all credentials and data transmission
  • Easy Setup – Simple OAuth connection process with minimal configuration

How It Works

  1. Install & Connect – Install the plugin and connect your store to WonderTax Labs
  2. Enable Tax Calculation – Optionally enable real-time tax calculation at checkout
  3. Automatic Tracking – All orders are automatically tracked for tax compliance
  4. Stay Compliant – WonderTax Labs handles the complexity of multi-state tax compliance

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • HTTPS-enabled site
  • WonderTax Labs account (sign up at app.wonder.tax)

Privacy & Security

This plugin connects to WonderTax Labs (app.wonder.tax) to provide tax calculation and compliance services. When you connect your store:

  • Order data (customer location, product details, amounts) is sent to WonderTax Labs
  • All data is transmitted securely over HTTPS
  • Credentials are encrypted using industry-standard encryption
  • No payment information is transmitted
  • Data is used solely for tax compliance purposes

Read our Privacy Policy for more information.

External Services

This plugin connects to WonderTax Labs (app.wonder.tax) to provide tax calculation and compliance services.

Service URL: https://app.wonder.tax

Service Documentation: https://app.wonder.tax/integrations/woocommerce/docs

Privacy Policy: https://wonder.tax/privacy

Terms of Service: https://wonder.tax/tos

Data transmitted includes:
* Order information (amounts, customer location, product details)
* Store information (name, currency, timezone)
* No payment or sensitive financial data is transmitted

All connections use HTTPS encryption and credentials are stored securely.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “WonderTax Labs”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Navigate to WooCommerce > WonderTax Labs
  6. Click “Connect to WonderTax Labs” to begin setup

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Navigate to WooCommerce > WonderTax Labs
  7. Click “Connect to WonderTax Labs” to begin setup

After Installation

  1. Click “Connect to WonderTax Labs” on the settings page
  2. Log in to your WonderTax Labs account (or create one)
  3. Authorize the connection
  4. Optionally enable real-time tax calculation
  5. Done! Your orders will now sync automatically
sections.faq:
Do I need a WonderTax Labs account?

Yes, you need a WonderTax Labs account to use this plugin. You can sign up for free at app.wonder.tax.

Does this plugin calculate taxes at checkout?

Yes, when enabled, the plugin provides real-time tax calculation during checkout. This feature is optional and can be toggled in the settings.

Will my historical orders be imported?

Yes, WonderTax Labs can import your historical orders for comprehensive tax compliance tracking. This is done through the WonderTax Labs dashboard after connecting your store.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all credentials are encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption, and all data transmission occurs over HTTPS. We follow industry best practices for security.

Which countries are supported?

Currently, WonderTax Labs focuses on US sales tax compliance. Support for additional countries may be added in the future.

Does this replace WooCommerce’s built-in tax system?

When real-time tax calculation is enabled, WonderTax Labs provides tax rates instead of WooCommerce’s built-in system. You can disable this feature at any time to revert to WooCommerce’s tax settings.

How do I disconnect my store?

Navigate to WooCommerce > WonderTax Labs and click “Disconnect Store”. This will remove all stored credentials and stop order syncing.

Where can I get support?

For support, please contact us at service@wonder.tax.
